title: Product character on a finite power
statement: For positive $m$, a natural number $n$, and a tuple $\alpha=(\alpha_i)_{i=1}^n$ of elements of $\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$, define a complex-valued additive character on $(\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^n$ by sending $x=(x_i)_{i=1}^n$ to $\prod_{i=1}^n \chi_{\alpha_i}(x_i)$, where $\chi_{\alpha_i}$ is the character associated to $\alpha_i$.
